senses.gloss:
अधृत अ-धृत, अस्, आ, अम्, not held, un-
restrained, uncontrolled; (अस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
आ-धृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. contained, supported.

अ-धृति, इस्, f. want of firmness or fortitude; laxity,
absence of control or restraint; incontinence; (इस्, इस्,
इ), unsteady.

अधृष्ट अ-धृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, (rt. धृष्), not
bold, modest; not put down, invincible, irresistible.
आ-धृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, checked, overcome.

अ-धृष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unassailable, invincible;
unapproachable; proud; (आ), f., N. of a river.

आधृ आ-धृ, cl. 1. P. -धरति, -धर्तुम्,
to hold, keep, support: Caus. P. -धारयति, -यितुम्,
to bring, supply: Pass. -ध्रियते, to be brought.

आधृष् आ-धृष्, cl. 5. P., Ved. -धृष्णोति,
-धर्षितुम्, to assail, defy, injure, overcome; cl.
10. P. -धर्षयति, -यितुम्, to injure, hurt, over-
come, defy; refute, convict: Intens. Ved. -दधर्-
षति or Leṭ of Caus. to overcome.
